states.name: Register and validate intake
states.inputs: Immutable case ID, original dispute amount, supplier/entity/currency, created date and policy version
states.activity: Verify identity, authorized source access, intake completeness and applicable policy date
states.stop_or_exception: Missing identity or governing version â†’ HOLD; risk â†’ specialist

states.name: Assemble evidence packet
states.inputs: Authorized SAP/Coupa/SharePoint/Outlook/TMS records and case scope
states.activity: Connectors retrieve exact records; optional LLM cites relevant passages and drafts summary; analyst checks sufficiency
states.outputs: Source IDs, versions, citations and explicit gaps
states.stop_or_exception: No fabricated evidence or final applicability decision

states.name: Assess evidence requirements
states.activity: Rules test presence using approved supplier/service exceptions; human tests adequacy
states.outputs: Complete evidence or named information request
states.stop_or_exception: Missing evidence â†’ W1; conflicts or ambiguity â†’ H1

states.name: Pending information
states.inputs: Missing item, assigned owner, request and due date
states.activity: Draft specific request; approved workflow follows up; retain elapsed pending time in SLA
states.outputs: New evidence with timestamp and provenance
states.stop_or_exception: No automatic rejection for missing item; no silent SLA clock reset

states.name: Establish applicable terms
states.accountable_owner: AP Analyst; Procurement / Legal for conflict
states.inputs: Executed documents, verified scope/dates, supplier rules
states.activity: LLM proposes cited interpretation; AP applies clear terms; specialist resolves authority gaps
states.outputs: Validated governing rule version or hold
states.stop_or_exception: Solara C1, conflicting terms, uncertain dates or historical-only support â†’ H1

states.name: Specialist authority hold
states.accountable_owner: Procurement / Legal / Tax / Finance Controls as applicable
states.inputs: Evidence brief, specific question, original amount, risk triggers
states.activity: Rules route known triggers; human can always escalate; authorized specialist records scoped decision
states.outputs: Authoritative evidence/decision record; unresolved stays on hold
states.stop_or_exception: No model confidence override; $50000 â†’ Finance Controls; Solara â†’ Procurement / Legal

states.name: Reconcile components and calculate
states.inputs: Validated governing terms, original scope, currency and component evidence
states.activity: Human verifies material extraction and scope; deterministic Decimal calculation reconciles supported and unsupported amounts
states.outputs: Reproducible calculation record plus proposed disposition
states.stop_or_exception: Apex MRG-2026-0139 unreconciled scope â†’ H1; no authority splitting

states.name: Prepare closure and decision packet
states.inputs: Proposed disposition, verified calculation, terms, evidence and required consultation
states.activity: LLM drafts cited notes/communication; rules check required references; human verifies substance
states.outputs: Reviewed draft packet with unresolved items visible
states.stop_or_exception: Completeness is not correctness; no external send or financial action

states.name: Obtain authorized decision
states.accountable_owner: Authorized AP role; required specialist consulted
states.inputs: Current case version, original disputed amount, authenticated delegation and consultation records
states.activity: Rule engine identifies required role; authenticated authorized human approves or rejects; any hold prevents progression
states.outputs: Version-bound human decision and approval record
states.stop_or_exception: At $50000 hold; specialist requirements survive low value; rejection/revision returns to S1

states.name: Execute approved disposition and communicate
states.inputs: Current verified approval, unchanged case hash, accepted communication and action plan
states.activity: TARGET ONLY: revalidate authority/state; idempotent posting; reconcile result; reviewed supplier communication; closure
states.outputs: System receipt, communication receipt and closed case audit trail
states.stop_or_exception: Pilot produces a simulated packet only. Stale approval or failed/unknown posting â†’ hold/reconcile; no blind retry

states.name: Quality review and reopening
states.inputs: Closed record, independent QA sample and new evidence
states.activity: Human reviews correctness; deterministic measurement tracks errors/reopens/review time
states.outputs: QA finding, learning record or versioned reopened case
states.stop_or_exception: New evidence/changed disposition invalidates prior approval for new execution; do not train on historic outcome as truth

edges.condition: Identity, permitted access and governing version verified
Cited evidence packet assembled with explicit gaps
Required evidence present and human-verified sufficient, with no unresolved conflict
New requested evidence received; preserve elapsed waiting time
Applicable terms verified and clear; no authority conflict
Authorized specialist supplied recorded evidence/decision resolving the hold
Original scope and currency reconciled; deterministic calculation verified
Human-reviewed draft packet complete; no unresolved substantive issue
Authenticated authorized human approved the current case version and all required consultations; no holds
Actual receipts reconciled in future production, or simulated packet recorded in read-only pilot
New evidence or QA finding warrants reopening; supersede prior approval for new execution
stale approval or execution result unknown
no reopening trigger; retain QA/audit record

pilot_boundary: S0-S6 are shadow/review support; current authorized process remains responsible for actual operations. S7 is simulated only. No live connectors or authority-granting service implemented.
